activations.name: inputs
activations.meaning: B=rows in the micro-batch, T=positions; each entry is a token id in [0, V)

activations.name: mask
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions; True where the position holds a real token rather than padding

activations.name: tok_emb
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; one learned vector per token id

activations.name: pos_emb
activations.meaning: 1=broadcast over rows, T=positions, D=d_model; one learned vector per absolute position

activations.name: resid_in
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; the residual stream as it enters block 0

activations.name: attn_bias
activations.meaning: B=rows, 1=broadcast over heads, T_q=querying position, T_k=attended position; 0 where the edge is allowed and -inf where it is not (future positions and padding)

activations.name: block0.ln1
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; the residual stream normalised per position before attention reads it

activations.name: block0.attn.qkv
activations.meaning: B=rows in the micro-batch, T=positions, 3D=query, key and value packed into one projection so it is a single matmul

activations.name: block0.attn.q
activations.meaning: B=rows, H=attention heads, T=positions asking the question, Dh=d_model/H, the slice of the channel each head owns

activations.name: block0.attn.k
activations.meaning: B=rows, H=heads, T=positions being asked about, Dh=per-head width

activations.name: block0.attn.v
activations.meaning: B=rows, H=heads, T=positions whose content gets carried, Dh=per-head width

activations.name: block0.attn.scores
activations.meaning: B=rows, H=heads, T_q=querying position, T_k=attended position; entry (b,h,i,j) is how much position i wants position j

activations.name: block0.attn.weights
activations.meaning: same axes as scores, now a distribution over T_k for each (row, head, T_q) -- each slice sums to 1

activations.name: block0.attn.context
activations.meaning: B=rows, H=heads, T=positions, Dh=per-head width; the value vectors averaged with the attention weights

activations.name: block0.attn.merged
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; the heads concatenated back into one channel axis

activations.name: block0.attn.out
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; attention's contribution to the residual stream

activations.name: block0.resid_attn
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; residual stream after attention has been added back

activations.name: block0.ln2
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; residual stream normalised again before the MLP reads it

activations.name: block0.mlp.hidden
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, F=d_ff, the wide inner width where the per-position nonlinearity happens

activations.name: block0.mlp.out
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; the MLP's contribution to the residual stream

activations.name: block0.resid_mlp
activations.meaning: B=rows, T=positions, D=d_model; residual stream leaving this block
